div.h1: Automated style review of guidance documents

ul.li: Every finding must contain a word-for-word quote from the document. The service automatically rejects and retries any finding it cannot find in the text — so no made-up issues.
If a revision is produced, it is checked so that no images, links or headings are ever lost or restructured — only the wording changes.
The reviewer cites the specific rule it is applying, so every finding can be traced back to published guidance.
